description: Image Description: The image displays a single, handwritten digit "9" in black ink on a white background. The digit is written in a cursive style, with a smooth, continuous stroke forming the loop and tail of the number. The top of the "9" is rounded and slightly open, while the lower part extends downward with a curved tail that loops back upward. The stroke appears consistent in thickness, suggesting it was drawn with a steady hand. The background is plain and uncluttered
